lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to turn a picture storyboard into code, block by block.
A storyboard is a row of pictures that shows what happens, in order.
For each picture, ask: does the character move, talk, or change?
Each picture becomes one or two blocks.
Run your code and compare it with the storyboard.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
